expo.name: BD Audit
expo.//slug: Stuck as the old name on purpose. Expo project slugs are immutable — the API exposes only displayName (already set to Rungs on expo.dev), and this must match EAS project 530bebab... or every EAS command fails. Changing it costs a brand-new Expo project and a new OTA update URL. Cosmetic only: it never appears in the built app.

plugins.photosPermission: BD Audit lets you attach a photo as proof when completing a task.
plugins.cameraPermission: BD Audit lets you take a photo as proof when completing a task.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: BD Audit records where an audit is signed, to confirm the auditor was at the branch.
